title: Outlook mobile: Purview DLP policy tips for iOS and Android (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The roadmap facts, default-off setting, configuration paths and policy-tip command are supported. Licensing notes should distinguish the licence for managing Cloud Policy from the underlying DLP entitlement, and the briefing should acknowledge conflicting Microsoft support documentation.

claims.claim: Outlook for Android and iOS supports Purview DLP policy tips; the reference also covers macOS.
claims.quote: Outlook for Android, iOS, and macOS now supports data loss prevention (DLP) policy tips with commonly used predicates and exceptions, advanced classifiers, and override capabilities.
claims.fix: Add: 'The current mobile reference documents support, while the older troubleshooting article still says policy tips are not supported for Outlook for Mac iOS clients.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/troubleshoot/microsoft-365/purview/data-loss-prevention/data-loss-prevention-policy-tips.

claims.claim: A policy tip warns the sender while composing a message that matches a DLP rule.
claims.quote: When these conditions are met, the policy tip displays untrusted recipients while the user is writing the mail in Outlook, before they send it.

claims.claim: The mobile reference documents commonly used predicates and exceptions, advanced classifiers and override capabilities.
claims.quote: Outlook for Android, iOS, and macOS now supports data loss prevention (DLP) policy tips with commonly used predicates and exceptions, advanced classifiers, and override capabilities.

claims.claim: The policy-tip UI is disabled by default and requires administrator enablement, making admin-opt-in the default state.
claims.quote: Policy Tip UI is turned off by default in Outlook for Android, iOS, and macOS to allow for administrators to test and perform user training prior to deployment.

claims.claim: Microsoft gives testing and user training before deployment as the reason for the disabled default.
claims.quote: to allow for administrators to test and perform user training prior to deployment.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 Apps admin center route runs through Customization, Policy Management, Policy configurations, Create, Start with the basics, Choose the scope and Configure Settings to Enable Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy tips in Outlook.
claims.quote: You can access this policy under Customization and Policy Management. ... Enable Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy tips in Outlook

claims.claim: The policy can target individuals or groups.
claims.quote: You can target policies to individuals or groups, so you can test and deploy policy tip UI as needed through your organization.

claims.claim: Disabled hides policy tips and Enabled shows them.
claims.quote: (default) Disabled policy tips aren't shown Enabled policy tips are shown

claims.claim: The mobile oversharing dialog is available with the necessary licences and configuration.
claims.quote: The oversharing dialog is available in DLP for Outlook for Android and iOS users when used with the necessary licenses and configuration.

claims.claim: The oversharing dialog displays warning, override or block pop-ups.
claims.quote: When you enable this feature in a DLP rule, it displays popups for warning, override, or block actions to end users who are sharing labeled or sensitive emails in Outlook for Android and iOS.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy applies to user objects, not device objects.
claims.quote: Policies only apply to user objects. ... A group might contain both device objects and user objects, but the device objects are ignored.

claims.quote: If the user isn't a member of a Microsoft Entra group that is assigned a policy configuration, the service informs Click-to-Run to check back in 24 hours for this user.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: When several rules match, only the most restrictive, highest-priority rule's policy tip is shown.
claims.quote: Content can match several rules in a DLP policy or several different DLP policies, but only the policy tip from the most restrictive rule that has the highest priority is shown.

claims.claim: The default email policy-tip text is 'Your email conflicts with a policy in your organization.'
claims.quote: Default text for policy tips in email ... Your email conflicts with a policy in your organization.

claims.claim: Custom policy-tip text is plain text and does not support HTML or tokens.
claims.quote: The NotifyPolicyTipCustomText parameter specifies the custom text in the Policy Tip notification message ... HTML tags and tokens (variables) aren't supported.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Custom policy-tip text has a maximum length of 256 characters.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy settings are available for Windows, macOS, iOS and Android, but not every setting supports every operating system.
claims.quote: Policy settings are available for devices running Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android, although not all policy settings are available for all operating systems.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The feature's licensing model is included, with a supported Cloud Policy licence required for targeted users.

A mobile-specific advanced-policy-tip licence list is not yet published.' Retain the cited Purview service description URL.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy supports most Microsoft 365 subscription plans that include Microsoft 365 Apps.
claims.quote: Cloud Policy supports most Microsoft 365 subscription plans that include Microsoft 365 Apps. Check your licensing documentation for specific requirements.
